info.screen.roleid.sin_pride:
Pride · Lucifer

Independent neutral. Instinct on, timer off. No shop/starting items.
G: 60s CD — copy a target role's base shop snapshot.
Glow + conventional-weapon immunity when ≥3 other survivors within 8; killing others breaks it for 5s.
Blocks early faction ends while alive; last survivor wins alone.
Submission: Mike
info.screen.roleid.sin_pride.simple:
Be the last one standing.
Copy shop / crowd immunity / solo win
info.screen.roleid.sin_envy:
Envy · Leviathan

Killer. Shop: knife/gun/psycho/lockpick/lights.
G: 90s mark aim target. Marked kills only if your gold ≤ theirs; loot a legal item or up to 100 gold.
Unmarked targets unrestricted. Wins with killers.
Submission: Mike
info.screen.roleid.sin_envy.simple:
Win with the killers.
Mark kill / loot / killer shop
info.screen.roleid.sin_wrath:
Wrath · Satan

Killer-aligned neutral. No shop; fake knife/gun; no instinct, can see timer.
Only good-faction lethal weapons advance anger stages; first 5 cancel death, then speed stacks, then death.
Each kill lowers stage; after insanity, 5 kills force death.
Blackout: not counted; shares personal win on killer victory.
Submission: Mike
info.screen.roleid.sin_wrath.simple:
Share victory with killers.
Anger stages / fake weapons / uncounted
info.screen.roleid.sin_greed:
Greed · Mammon

Independent neutral. Shop: lockpick; bound pouch start.
Win alone when unique item kinds hit ceil(startPlayers×2.5). Losing the pouch kills you.
G: anonymous trade — crosshair player + sample item; sell if collected, else buy. Dual chat confirm; price tiers 0–3.
Submission: Mike
info.screen.roleid.sin_greed.simple:
Collect enough item kinds.
Bound pouch / anonymous trade / solo win

info.screen.roleid.sin_gluttony:
Gluttony · Beelzebub

Innocent. Dynamic edible shop; milk/honey for sale.
Real consumption grants random buffs that upgrade, then permanent for the round at cap.
Scrubs registered common debuffs. Wins with goods.
Submission: Mike
info.screen.roleid.sin_gluttony.simple:
Win with the innocents.
Eat buffs / scrub debuffs / good shop
info.screen.roleid.sin_lust:
Lust · Asmodeus

Independent neutral. Shop: lockpick; instinct + timer.
Phase 1: read-only lover highlight and charge near dual lovers.
Phase 2: once mark all other survivors with desire (not true lovers).
Any true-lovers win while you live → victory becomes Lust.
Submission: Mike
info.screen.roleid.sin_lust.simple:
Crown yourself on lovers' victory.
Lover highlight / desire mark / hijack win

info.screen.roleid.sin_sloth:
Sloth · Belphegor

Independent neutral. Normal in safety; sleep + shield when safety ends.
Sleep locks movement/items/attacks/etc.; broken shield wakes with berserk.
Once per match active wake: consume shield, explode, berserk. If alive when a normal faction would win → Sloth wins.
Submission: Mike

Steal victory between sleep and wake.
Sleep shield / berserk / hijack win
